puzzle.hint: Allah's reassuring words to two prophets facing a powerful tyrant — a reminder of His constant presence, hearing, and sight over all.
puzzle.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
puzzle.verseEn: [Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
